query: UPDATE assistant_actions SET state='dispatching',proposal=NULL,dispatched_at=now() WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND login_id=$3 AND id=$4 AND session_id=$5 AND operation_id=$6 AND request_hash=$7 AND batch_id IS NULL AND state='approved' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND (NOT $8 OR (review_facts->>'version'='1' AND review_facts->>'operation_id'=$6 AND review_facts->'facts'->>'kind' IS NOT NULL AND (coalesce(review_facts->'facts'->'locked','null'::jsonb)<>'null'::jsonb OR coalesce(review_facts->'facts'->'priced','null'::jsonb)<>'null'::jsonb))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_sessions s WHERE s.workspace_id=$1 AND s.id=$5 AND s.user_id=$2 AND s.login_id=$3 AND s.state='active' AND s.expires_at>now() AND s.last_seen_at>now()-interval '15 minutes') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=$3 AND t.user_id=$2 AND t.expires_at>clock_timestamp()) RETURNING review_facts AS "facts!"
